content: Amfarisi anà Asadusu ban'lɔm idiim
Amfarisi anà Asadusi bàyi akà Yɛsu ntɔn mukun'lɛɛ untaam. Ba bun'lɔ̈ɔ̈m idiim mwɛy kyan'fà du.
Nde kafuur naa: « Umpal làfàkàminà taaŋ, bɛ làfàtɛn naa: "Du làyàkal ubwaŋ ntɔn la là làtsöö."
Ututu naa: "Mbul akyer anɔ ŋàbà, ntɔn du lan'yeen." Bɛ, bɛ làyöb nà musyeebà mpɛl naa du lye aben, wɛɛ idiim a an'taaŋ bɛ làkwo anki muyöb bya!
Nkööl a baar abe anà yà inswem yàmulɔm idiim. Wɛɛ akà idiim asin bàsun'pà anki, idiim nsil kyà Yɔnas. » Nde laa kàsawɛy nde, waa kàkyen.
Ful a Amfarisi anà Asadusi
Mpal bàsabà alɔŋki u sim lumwɛy, ba bàkyärà mpiim muwal mampà.
Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: « Làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ ntɔn ful a Amfarisi anà Asadusi! »
Alɔŋki bàyweerà abà: « Ntɔn bi mampà iwɛl anki. »
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kàmɛn nde an'kyän aba, nde kàtɛn a ba naa: « Baar a làkwikilà a ikikye, ntɔn nkye làkayweerà bɛ ntɔn làkɔ̈ɔ̈n bɛ mampà?
Bɛ ŋàtàyöb anki? Bɛ làfàkayɔbà anki mampà an'tyeen ntɔn nsaab tyeen, anà in'lwaŋ in'kwe bɛ làsyen?
Itàkal mampà nsambwaar ntɔn nsaab nà, anà in'lwaŋ in'kwe bɛ làsyen?
Bɛ làkɔɔn akayöbà aben naa kà ntɔn mampà anki in'tɛɛnà mɛ a bɛ naa: Làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ ntɔn ful a Amfarisi anà Asadusi! »
Apan, ba bàyöb naa nde kàtɛɛnà anki a ba mukal kà igyɛɛŋ ntɔn ful a mampà, wɛɛ ntɔn an'lɔɔŋ a Amfarisi anà Asadusi.
Petɔlà kan'tɛn naa Yɛsu wà Mwan a Nzam
Umpal kàkɔlà nde kà itiir a nsi a Sɛzarɛ u Filipe, Yɛsu kàfuul alɔŋki ande naa: « Baar bàfàtɛn naa Mwan a mbuur wa nà? »
Ba bàtɛn naa: « Ntɔn bumwɛy, Ywan Un'düümà, bumwɛy naa Ԑli, bumwɛy naa Yɛlɛmya, taaŋ lumwɛy naa umwɛy uboo a aŋangɔɔm. »
Nde waa kàtɛn a ba naa: « Atöl bɛ, bɛ làfàtɛn naa mɛ in'wà nà? »
Simɔn Petɔlà kàfuur naa: « Ngye, Ngye awà Klistɔ, Mwan a Nzam a mɔ̈ɔ̈. »
Apan, Yɛsu waa kun'kyään naa: « Un'sak akà ngye Simɔn, mwan a Yɔnas, ntɔn kà ngye ŋakwo anki an'yöb ya, wɛɛ Taaràmɛ awà u du kàmayɔɔb.
Waa mɛ, mɛ akyään naa ngye awà nkɔŋ, udu a nkɔŋ ayi mɛ in'sàtɔŋ Ikööŋ amɛ, ngwal a ukwà isàkal anki anà ikɔ̈b udu a kya.
Mɛ in'sapà nsab a Imwol a du: Undiir wanswà asàbäm ngye u mɛɛn, wa sye asàkal wàŋàbäm u du, undiir wanswà asàtsuuŋ ngye u mɛɛn, wa asàkal wàŋàtsuuŋ u du. »
Apan, Yɛsu kàswɛŋ alɔŋki ande a ngwal naa ba bàkɔɔn akyään baar naa nde wà Klistɔ.
Yɛsu kan'kyään nkweel anà ngwiiyà ande

Fà taaŋ alan, Yɛsu kàsɛmà muswaŋ alɔŋki ande naa yan'kwo naa nde ubeenà Yɛlusàlɛm, ukàman mpay mbɔɔn kà an'kɔɔ a andweer, a amfum a angaŋ anà mà alɔɔŋ a Un'kɔɔn. Ba bàkyer akun'dwa, wɛɛ kà ilä kyàtär nde akyer asàwiyà.
Petɔlà kun'bel ukɔl, waa kàsɛmà mukun'ŋän anà mutɛn naa: « Mwol, Nzam akyer ayabay, ndaa ayi iyabweel anki! »
Wɛɛ nde, kàbulà nde, waa kàtɛn a Petɔlà: « Kyà kunà, Satanà! Lwomà apà mɛ pà! Ngye awà kyà u mbwo amɛ, ntɔn an'kyän angye kà mà an'kyän a Nzam anki, wɛɛ mà baar. »
Apan, Yɛsu kàtɛn a alɔŋki ande naa: « Isàkal naa mbuur akwen mukan'lab, wɛy nde ukɔɔb mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande ŋakwo, uwɛl kulunsi ande, wɛy nde kan'läb.
Ntɔn mbuur usàkwen mutswà möö ande, wa asàkyà bwà. Wɛɛ mbuur usàpiy möö ande ntɔn mɛ, nde asàtswà wa.
Bweel nà mbuur usàkal abà, itàkal naa nde kan'wal mɛɛn aŋukiinà, wɛɛ mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande ukyà bwà? Itàkal naa undiir nà wà ndöŋ mbuur kan'kwo mupà ntɔn musom mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande?
Ntɔn Mwan a mbuur asàyà unsà làkoo a Taarànde anà akyeey ande, apan nde asàfuur akà mbuur mbuur asànaa yàkäl nsyääl ande.
Mɛ, mɛ alàkyään ndandaa naa amwɛy uboo a baar bà pà bàsàkal aŋàkwà anki kusà muman Mwan a mbuur wàmuyà unsà imwol ande. »
